query:
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name, u.login_method, u.role, u.open_id,
       c.id as cred_id, c.is_active, c.password_hash, c.created_at as cred_created
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN sub_account_credentials c ON c.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.email = 'info@optimallendingsolutions.com';
